comment: Games named in the Phase-15 evaluation brief as already tested by hand, but whose PGN and recorded verdict have NOT been supplied to this tool yet.
They are listed here so the dataset and the failure report can honestly account for them as MISSING rather than silently under-reporting the corpus.
The 'description' field is a restatement of how the game was described in the brief. It is NOT a verdict and NOT a label — no verdict has been inferred, guessed, or back-filled by tooling.

To promote one of these to a real record: drop the .pgn into tools/evaluation/corpus/real/ named <game_id>.pgn, re-run runCorpus.mjs, then buildLabels.mjs, then fill in the human fields in labels.json.
